$Comment: Ice rain (2026-10-21, concept 'ANYBODY?!': shoots ice bolts into the sky and many icebergs fall around in an area). 1.5 s charge with the hand glow, a bolt shot almost straight up (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain_Up, IgnorePitch so the offset is from level), then the beacon AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain: the encounter drops 10 shards around every player in range in three waves (Stalactite_Ground_Indicator under each). Without the encounter only the bolt happens. Animation: own IDs IceRainCharging / IceRainCast (2026-10-21). 2026-10-21 (playtest: one bolt into the sky per icicle; the single slow bolt looked lame): after the charge, IceRainVolley (art: a looping throw, right hand up at 0.067 s, left at 0.217 s, every 0.3 s) and 10 sky bolts 0.15 s apart in step with it, right/left by turns (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain_Up_R/_L), first at 0.067 s; then the beacon (the encounter drops the 10 icicles in three waves) and 0.4 s of IceRainCast. 2026-10-21 (art: IceRainVolley is now exactly 10 throws, one every 1/6 s = 5 server ticks, the looping one drifted): bolts every 0.1667 s after the 0.067 s lead, in step with the throws; each bolt step plays SFX_Staff_Ice_Shoot (Effects WorldSoundEventId) so every bolt is heard leaving the hand (the projectile's LaunchWorldSoundEventId was not heard for an NPC). 2026-10-21 (art): the per-bolt step sound is removed again; each bolt sounds once through its projectile config's LaunchWorldSoundEventId (it plays twice otherwise).
